LanguageData.LC_Settings_ShowFourColorHitIconsDesc: Display floating resistance grade/effectiveness icons above struck targets when four-color damage hits.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_ShowFourColorDamageNumbersDe: Display color-coded numeric four-color damage values (RED / WHITE / BLACK / PALE) when hits connect.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_GuaranteedFourColorHitDesc: Make all E.G.O / four-color weapons and Abnormality / Ordeal attacks always hit, ignoring cover, weather, miss, and melee dodge (active skills and Magic Bullet always hit regardless of this setting).
LanguageData.LC_Settings_GlobalDamageScaleDesc: Global multiplier applied to four-color damage calculations.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_CompatHeader: Vanilla / DLC / Mod Apparel & Race Compatibility
LanguageData.LC_Settings_EnableFourColorDefaultsDesc: Apply built-in four-color risk levels and resistances to vanilla and DLC armors defined in FourColorDefaults.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_AutoInferApparel: Auto-infer four-color profiles for unconfigured armor
LanguageData.LC_Settings_AutoInferApparelDesc: Automatically derive conservative four-color defense profiles for modded or unconfigured protective apparel using Sharp/Blunt/Heat armor ratings.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_EnableQualityScaling: Enable quality scaling for compatibility gear
LanguageData.LC_Settings_EnableQualityScalingDesc: Scale non-E.G.O weapon damage multipliers and apparel four-color resistances by item quality.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_ApplyQualityToEGO: Also apply quality scaling to E.G.O equipment
LanguageData.LC_Settings_ApplyQualityToEGODesc: Allow item quality to scale authored E.G.O weapons and E.G.O suits (off by default to preserve canon values).
LanguageData.LC_Page_ApparelHint: Lower resistance values reduce incoming damage. Editing any row creates a runtime override; click Revert to restore its authored, default-table, or inferred profile.
LanguageData.LC_Page_WeaponHint: Assign a four-color damage type, risk grade, and output multiplier to override or enable four-color scaling for any weapon.
LanguageData.LC_Page_RaceHint: Customize race baseline four-color resistances and target classification. Click Revert to restore defaults.
LanguageData.LC_Settings_ShowQliphothMeltdownHud: Show top-left Qliphoth Meltdown HUD bar
LanguageData.LC_Settings_ShowManagerBulletHud: Show top-left Manager Bullets quick-cast bar
LanguageData.LC_Settings_EnableMeltdownOrdealTrigger: Trigger scheduled Ordeals on Qliphoth Meltdown milestones
